whatIs: Footer is a curated gallery of footers from real sites. Each entry has a thumbnail, the name, a short description and links to its detail page and to the live site; some carry the "Editor's Choice" badge.

It's organized by type and style, with categories like Typographic, Grid, Animated, Cards, Dark or Large Type, and a "browse" page with all of them. It's useful when you only need to solve that one section.
uses: Looking at large-type footers before deciding how to close out a landing page.
Comparing how footers with many columns and footers with almost none organize their links.
Looking for examples of animated footers to inspire an effect when you reach the bottom of the page.
caveats: It has no search; you can only browse by category and through pages with "Load more".
It shows only footers, so it doesn't help with the rest of the page.
It includes the occasional sponsored ad among the results.
pricingNote: Free to browse, with no account.
idealFor: People who need specific footer references.
